hero.subtitle: A powerful, modern PDF reader designed for language learners. Read native content, translate instantly, and build vocabulary seamlessly.

features.title: Why LinguaReader?
features.subtitle: Everything you need to turn reading into language learning.

pdf_reader.title: Smart PDF Reading
pdf_reader.desc: Resume anywhere with automatic progress tracking. Focus mode cleans up the interface for deep reading sessions.

translation.title: Instant Contextual Translation
translation.desc: Click any word to translate instantly. Understand detailed nuances with full sentence translations powered by AI.

srs.title: Vocabulary Building (SRS)
srs.desc: Save words to custom lists. Master them with the built-in Spaced Repetition System and interactive flashcards.

customizable.title: Modern & Customizable
customizable.desc: Beautiful Dark and Light modes. Visualize your daily progress with interactive charts and graphs.

import_export.title: Import / Export Compliance
import_export.desc: Backup your data safely or bring your own word lists. Supports flexible JSON format for easy sharing and community lists.

download.title: Get LinguaReader
download.fetch_error: Could not fetch latest release info.

custom_lists.title: Build Custom Lists
custom_lists.subtitle: Create tailored vocabulary lists with our open JSON format. Share with friends or import from other tools.

required_structure.title: Required Structure
required_structure.desc: The root object defines metadata for your list. The <1>words</1> array contains your vocabulary items.

steps.s1_desc: Create a new .json file on your desktop.
steps.s2_desc: Fill it with your vocabulary following the structure above.
steps.s3_desc: Open LinguaReader, go to Settings -> Import.

contribution.title: Join the Community
contribution.subtitle: Help us make LinguaReader better for everyone. Whether you code, design, or speak multiple languages, your contribution matters.

feedback.title: Have Feedback?
feedback.desc: Found a bug or have a feature request? Open an issue on GitHub to let us know.

tutorial.title: How to Contribute
tutorial.step1_desc: Fork the repo to your account and clone it locally.
tutorial.step2_desc: Create a feature branch and implement your changes.
tutorial.step3_desc: Push your changes and open a Pull Request.

thanks.title: Thank You!
thanks.message: To everyone who has contributed: your code, feedback, and support drive this project forward. Together, we are building the best open-source tool for language learners.
